metadata.explanation: Drop a failure notification whose delivery exhausted its retries; the deployment keeps the failure.
Acquire the Project deployment lease, which assigns this attempt's generation.
Register exact Project membership before any provider effect.
Tell the Project's goal measurement that this deployment is Live, with its revision, build commit and Live commit time.
Run the generation's application from its immutable image once its grant and project Dex are usable, polling without locks.
Wait for an admitted retry or Project cleanup request.
Join the one result of each preparation branch and commit what they prepared, or the failure that ends the round.
Revoke and remove the generation of a deleting Project or a cancelled deployment, polling without locks until it is gone or the wait limit passes.
Activate the ready generation and commit it as the Project's Live pointer, polling without locks until the public route serves it.
Commit provider observations and timings before advancing the durable lifecycle; tell the Session of a failure outside Project cleanup.
Keep the replaced generation running for the drain window, so in-flight requests and reads finish; Project cleanup ends the wait.
Tell the Project's Session, best effort, of the failure the commit recorded, then wait for a retry or Project cleanup.

Record the Live usages of the TeamSpace connections the version selects, then prepare or reuse the access of the Live Dex and applications, the generation's Service and its workload grant; holds no lock.
Start a new round that prepares the Live Temporal and the Live access in parallel, and its join.
Prepare or reuse the project's Live Temporal namespace and credential until its data plane accepts the credential, handing new identities to the Project; holds no lock.
Publish the build's Flow Definitions to the project's storage without activating them.
Record a failed candidate stop with its exact identity while retaining the original provider phase and lease for retry.
Turn the redacted cause of a failed phase into the failure to commit for query-first recovery.
Record in the deployment's progress that its Live announcement failed and go on; the next deployment announces again.
Publish the failed result of a preparation branch whose attempts failed or passed its wait limit, with its classified cause.
Release the Project deployment lease of this exact generation.
Ask the Live generation this one replaced to retire, while this one still holds the Project lease.
Revoke the replaced generation's workload grant, then remove its objects, polling without locks until they are gone.
Start the project's Live Dex on the prepared Temporal, handing its Service to the Project, polling without locks until it is ready.
Stop the exact failed candidate Worker before reporting a pre-activation failure; never stop a generation already committed as Live.
Stop the exact replaced Worker after activation, retaining its HTTP generation until retirement.
Observe the application, polling without locks until it serves the pinned image and definitions.
Pin the exact ready build, its frozen configuration and the Project's storage.
